name: Canvon Floating Buttons
author: canvon

sections.description:
Canvon Floating Buttons helps site owners add quick-access contact, messaging, and social buttons to their website. It can display buttons for chat apps, social profiles, phone numbers, and email addresses in a floating widget on the front end of the site.

The plugin can be used without creating an account or entering a license key.

Features

  • Add floating buttons for messaging, social, phone, and email contact methods.
  • Configure the widget position, size, shape, color, and icon text.
  • Choose whether each button appears on desktop, mobile, or both.
  • Preview the floating widget from the settings screen.
  • Link buttons to social profiles, chat apps, phone numbers, or email addresses.

External Services

Canvon Floating Buttons uses Freemius for optional account connection, licensing, checkout, upgrade, and paid-version delivery flows. The plugin contacts Freemius only when you choose to connect an account, activate or manage a license, open checkout or pricing screens, opt in to Freemius-powered account features, or download a paid version.

Depending on the action you choose, Freemius may receive basic site and account information needed for those services, such as the site URL, plugin version, WordPress/PHP environment details, license/account identifiers, and the email address associated with the connected account. This data is used by Freemius to provide licensing, checkout, account management, update, and paid-version delivery services.

If you do not connect an account, activate a license, open checkout/pricing, or opt in to Freemius account features, those Freemius account and licensing services are not used.

Freemius terms: https://freemius.com/terms/
Freemius privacy policy: https://freemius.com/privacy/
sections.faq:
Do I need a paid license to use Canvon Floating Buttons?

No. Canvon Floating Buttons can be used without a paid license.

Do I need to connect an account?

No. Account connection is optional. The plugin can run without connecting to Freemius.
